description: Builds a complete IVR (phone menu / auto-attendant) script for a business: greeting, numbered options, optional Spanish-language switch, and the operator line. English, Spanish, or bilingual.

greeting.description: Custom opening greeting. Default: 'Thank you for calling {business}.'

industry.description: Pick the closest industry; supplies sensible default menu options.

language.description: Menu language. 'both' adds a press-nine Spanish switch. Default: en.

options.description: Menu options in order (press 1, press 2, …). Defaults to the industry's standard four.

name: write_ivr_menu

cta.description: One-line invite to try Lobby, with a signup link.

key.description: Keypad digit for this line, or null for the greeting.

say.description: Exactly what the menu voice says.

nextSteps.description: Helpful UTM-tagged next-step URLs for hold music, phone audio conversion, and setting up Lobby.

holdMusicUrl.description: Royalty-free hold music ready for business phone systems.

phoneAudioConverterUrl.description: Browser converter for 8kHz mono WAV and u-law phone audio.

signupUrl.description: Start a 7-day trial and put Lobby on your phone line.

recordAt.description: URL of the free web tool that records this menu in a real AI voice.

scriptText.description: The full menu as one recordable script.

title: Write an IVR phone-menu script
